properties.gist: father, ageing, still in the hometown house; talks in gutters and weather
properties.texture: his 'ah, it's you' landing flat — not cold, just the air going out of it; the way a man lowers himself into a chair he's tired of
properties.charge: guilt-tinged tenderness; the thing never said
properties.source: traces/testbed-20260601-151223, testbed-20260601-152058 (manifest said 'a parent'; the traces made him a father)

properties.gist: the friend from the hometown years; a woman; her laugh cracked at the end of every sentence like she couldn't help it
properties.charge: loss that arrives sideways; the seat no longer saved

properties.gist: the mid-sized town they grew up in; the kind of place you get on with
the long grass and chain-link behind the Caltex on the edge of town
properties.texture: cicadas loud in the heat; the fence warm against your back

properties.gist: his kitchen; lino floor, wall phone, kettle, the radio low on Saturday mornings
properties.texture: a Sunday smell, something overcooked; the television murmuring in the next room; his chair angled away from the doorway

properties.gist: the wall phone with the long coiled cord, stretched thin from the wall

properties.gist: the phone-call relationship; love routed through weather and gutters
properties.texture: none of it the thing, all of it the way in; he answers mid-thought, as if the conversation had only paused for a breath and not for months

properties.gist: saying 'mm' at the right gaps while he talks
properties.texture: learned young, on Saturday mornings, the radio low under it

properties.gist: opening every call with the weather, the car, the neighbour's fence
two bikes dropped in the long grass behind the Caltex, the summer the cicadas got that loud; splitting a warm can of lemonade, backwash and all
properties.charge: unguarded belonging, before anything was counted

properties.gist: a borrowed sofa, four in the morning, feet tangled at the wrong end; a film neither of them was watching, the talk going on and on, certain it would always be there to come back to
